summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with one parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (39 passed), and the full test/test_extras directory passes (97 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed). Nothing is committed. mypy, black, ruff and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting and type-ignore placement were checked by reading the code only. The parser uses value() lookups instead of membership tests because None acts as a wildcard in membership checks.
